definitions.conditional_independence: Given X, model correctness draws are independent Bernoulli variables with heterogeneous known probabilities p_j(X).
definitions.false_dependence_win: At a matched fixed depth, a heuristic has lower empirical test risk than exact factorization even though its conditional population risk is no lower.
definitions.pooled_raw_correlation: Mean off-diagonal Pearson correlation of design correctness labels, without conditioning on X.
definitions.residual_correlation: Mean off-diagonal Pearson correlation of design residuals Y - p_j(X).
definitions.uncertainty: Means use seed-level standard errors and normal 95 percent intervals. Frequencies use Wilson 95 percent intervals.
